gemini.reason: Recorded consumer route excluded from delegation and integration

provenance: Supplied-context reviews of design/candidate revisions, not independent workspace verification. Final source freeze preceded final native recording. touchedFiles can reflect concurrent parent edits; recursive tool event audit found zero.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 1-2: split UTF8 and bounded read sizes
museDesignDisposition.decision: Already covered: bytes go to frozen line framer before decoding; stdout read(7), stderr read(4096). Capture verifies Unicode and minimum stdout read count.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 3-5,10: EOF/exit separation, timeout and cleanup order, concurrent draining
museDesignDisposition.decision: Separate stdout/stderr/wait tasks under activity deadline; cleanup in finally afterward kills owned direct child and waits before settling remaining tasks. Prefix capture intentionally does not claim full postkill drain. Abort closure labeled separately from observed EOF.
One stdout coroutine owns callback/reply handling; no competing writer. Added explicit refusal of any second planned synthetic denial before final recording. Frozen callbacks are single-use.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 7: closed-input write can block or be cancelled
museDesignDisposition.decision: Barrier precedes single bounded fault write; activity deadline covers send/drain/closure. Added cancellation uncertainty state. Final capture observed ConnectionResetError, no retry.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 8: successful local drain is not peer acceptance
museDesignDisposition.decision: No writes in eof-pending. Exact peer replyObserved plus completion and exit0 required for roundtrip capture. No task success claimed.
Counters include overflow read, retained prefixes capped separately. Explicitly not total child output or all postkill bytes.
Bounded writer close/wait, transport abort on timeout; direct child wait and task settlement gates pass. No independent OS handle inventory or total transport cleanup qualification claimed.

museDesignDisposition.findings: 12: absolute peer path and Python startup environment
museDesignDisposition.decision: Absolute fixed path and scenario allowlist already present; added -I before final recording. No generic arbitrary-command launcher or full environment-isolation claim.
Hashes use actual retained bytes; output directory and scenario files created exclusively. Saved --check uses in-process assertions and hashes, never launches another peer.

parentVerification.testGuard: Eight behavior tests against real captured peers, no mocks; flood/cleanup variants use subTest. No remaining violations.
